charts.title: TOI-181 b: orbits around TOI-181
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-181's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-181 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Mistry et al. 2023 (2023MNRAS.521.1066M), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname MISTRY_ET_AL_2023): P 4.532 d

charts.title: TOI-181 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-181 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (69, 96, 106) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 76923707, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 5 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 8-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min late; 8-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 2 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
